subject: RCurl not working with Shiny-Server on Ubuntu 12.04

messages.author: 36eb6fceac155281
messages.subject: RCurl not working with Shiny-Server on Ubuntu 12.04
parts:
Hello any shiny-server admins willing to help, I'm running a script that attempts to go to a url, collect a csv and plot some count info. I'm attempting to use the RCurl function getURL with the userpwd option to give simple authorization to the site. It works when I run it under the shiny user via terminal, but when I run it as a server it returns a "cannot open connection" error. I'm going to try to change the log level but first I wanted to see if anyone has encountered this problem, or if there are any other debugging tips out there.

Much appreciated
-Robert

messages.author: 5ab11db47365dff1
messages.subject: Re: RCurl not working with Shiny-Server on Ubuntu 12.04
parts:
My first instinct is to check ip tables. Perhaps the terminal uses an open port while the server does not. Type

iptables -L

And it will summarize the software firewall rules.

You can remove all rules with

iptables -F

Of course for security reasons you'll need to add them back.

Just a guess....

messages.subject: Re: RCurl not working with Shiny-Server on Ubuntu 12.04
parts:
I've attempted to configure my iptables - as of right now this is how they look:

rg@ubuntu:~$ sudo iptables -L
Chain INPUT (policy ACCEPT)
target     prot opt source               destination        
ACCEPT     tcp  --  anywhere             anywhere             tcp dpt:3838
ACCEPT     all  --  anywhere             anywhere           
ACCEPT     all  --  anywhere             anywhere             ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED
ACCEPT     tcp  --  anywhere             anywhere             tcp dpt:http
DROP       all  --  anywhere             anywhere           

Chain FORWARD (policy ACCEPT)
target     prot opt source               destination        

Chain OUTPUT (policy ACCEPT)
target     prot opt source               destination        




However, I continue to get the same "can't open connection" error.  I have a feeling it is due to with the permissions setting for the server. I read elsewhere that the default is the root user. I have a feeling its the same with my case, but then I check the shiny-server log file and it says:

Warning in file(file, ifelse(append, "a", "w")) :
  cannot open file 'wawa.csv': Permission denied

Error in file(file, ifelse(append, "a", "w")) :
  cannot open the connection

I don't know why the warning came before the error.
I'm guessing that this is due to my permissions setting for root user or shiny user.
Any help or references would be greatly apprectiated

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: RCurl not working with Shiny-Server on Ubuntu 12.04
parts:
Robert,

Is this: 'wawa.csv' a file on your filesystem? If so, what are the permissions on it?

Just to help you diagnose the problem: 
Depending on how you are configuring your Shiny Server, and how you are accessing your application, the R process that is trying to access the file could be run as different users, and it is possible that the user does not have permission on this file (if this is on your file system).

You could send us your Shiny Server configuration file, and also the URL that you use to launch the application.

Fereshteh
